2309    def gene_calculation(self):
2310        """
2311        Calculate and store per-cell counts (e.g., number of detected genes).
2312
2313        The method computes a binary (presence/absence) per cell and sums across
2314        features to produce `self.gene_calc`.
2315
2316        Update
2317        ------
2318        Sets `self.gene_calc` as a pandas.Series.
2319
2320        Side Effects
2321        ------------
2322        Uses `self.input_data` when available, otherwise `self.normalized_data`.
2323        """
2324
2325        if self.input_data is not None:
2326
2327            bin_col = self.input_data.columns.copy()
2328
2329            bin_col = bin_col.where(bin_col <= 0, 1)
2330
2331            sum_data = bin_col.sum(axis=0)
2332
2333            self.gene_calc = sum_data
2334
2335        elif self.normalized_data is not None:
2336
2337            bin_col = self.normalized_data.copy()
2338
2339            bin_col = bin_col.where(bin_col <= 0, 1)
2340
2341            sum_data = bin_col.sum(axis=0)
2342
2343            self.gene_calc = sum_data
2344
2345    def gene_histograme(self, bins=100):
2346        """
2347        Plot a histogram of the number of genes detected per cell.
2348
2349        Parameters
2350        ----------
2351        bins : int, default 100
2352            Number of histogram bins.
2353
2354        Returns
2355        -------
2356        matplotlib.figure.Figure
2357            Figure containing the histogram of gene contents.
2358
2359        Notes
2360        -----
2361        Requires `self.gene_calc` to be computed prior to calling.
2362        """
2363
2364        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
2365
2366        _, bin_edges, _ = ax.hist(
2367            self.gene_calc, bins=bins, edgecolor="black", alpha=0.6
2368        )
2369
2370        mu, sigma = np.mean(self.gene_calc), np.std(self.gene_calc)
2371
2372        x = np.linspace(min(self.gene_calc), max(self.gene_calc), 1000)
2373        y = norm.pdf(x, mu, sigma)
2374
2375        y_scaled = y * len(self.gene_calc) * (bin_edges[1] - bin_edges[0])
2376
2377        ax.plot(
2378            x, y_scaled, "r-", linewidth=2, label=f"Normal(μ={mu:.2f}, σ={sigma:.2f})"
2379        )
2380
2381        ax.set_xlabel("Value")
2382        ax.set_ylabel("Count")
2383        ax.set_title("Histogram of genes detected per cell")
2384
2385        ax.set_xticks(np.linspace(min(self.gene_calc), max(self.gene_calc), 20))
2386        ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=90)
2387
2388        ax.legend()
2389
2390        return fig

2392    def gene_threshold(self, min_n: int | None, max_n: int | None):
2393        """
2394        Filter cells by gene-detection thresholds (min and/or max).
2395
2396        Parameters
2397        ----------
2398        min_n : int or None
2399            Minimum number of detected genes required to keep a cell.
2400
2401        max_n : int or None
2402            Maximum number of detected genes allowed to keep a cell.
2403
2404        Update
2405        -------
2406        Filters `self.input_data`, `self.normalized_data`, `self.input_metadata`
2407        (and calls `average()` if `self.agg_normalized_data` exists).
2408
2409        Side Effects
2410        ------------
2411        Raises ValueError if both bounds are None or if filtering removes all cells.
2412        """
2413
2414        if min_n is not None and max_n is not None:
2415            mask = (self.gene_calc > min_n) & (self.gene_calc < max_n)
2416        elif min_n is None and max_n is not None:
2417            mask = self.gene_calc < max_n
2418        elif min_n is not None and max_n is None:
2419            mask = self.gene_calc > min_n
2420        else:
2421            raise ValueError("Lack of both min_n and max_n values")
2422
2423        if self.input_data is not None:
2424
2425            if len([y for y in mask if y is False]) == 0:
2426                raise ValueError("Nothing to reduce")
2427
2428            self.input_data = self.input_data.loc[:, mask.values]
2429
2430        if self.normalized_data is not None:
2431
2432            if len([y for y in mask if y is False]) == 0:
2433                raise ValueError("Nothing to reduce")
2434
2435            self.normalized_data = self.normalized_data.loc[:, mask.values]
2436
2437        if self.input_metadata is not None:
2438
2439            if len([y for y in mask if y is False]) == 0:
2440                raise ValueError("Nothing to reduce")
2441
2442            self.input_metadata = self.input_metadata.loc[mask.values, :].reset_index(
2443                drop=True
2444            )
2445
2446            self.input_metadata = self.input_metadata.drop(
2447                columns=["drop"], errors="ignore"
2448            )
2449
2450        if self.agg_normalized_data is not None:
2451            self.average()
2452
2453        self.gene_calculation()
2454        self.cells_calculation()
2455
2456    def cells_calculation(self, name_slot="cell_names"):

2461        cells.

2463        Parameters
2464        ----------

2472
2473        ls = list(self.input_metadata[name_slot])
2474
2475        df = pd.DataFrame(
2476            {
2477                "cluster": pd.Series(ls).value_counts().index,
2478                "n": pd.Series(ls).value_counts().values,
2479            }
2480        )
2481
2482        self.cells_calc = df

2595                    self.normalized_data = self.normalized_data.loc[:, mask]

2600

2603                ]

2649    def load_sparse_from_projects(self, normalized_data: bool = False):
2650        """
2651        Load sparse 10x-style datasets from stored project paths, concatenate them,
2652        and populate `input_data` / `normalized_data` and `input_metadata`.
2653
2654        Parameters
2655        ----------
2656        normalized_data : bool, default False
2657            If True, store concatenated tables in `self.normalized_data`.
2658            If False, store them in `self.input_data` and normalization
2659            is needed using normalize_data() method.
2660
2661        Side Effects
2662        ------------
2663        - Reads each project using `load_sparse(...)` (expects matrix.mtx, genes.tsv, barcodes.tsv).
2664        - Concatenates all projects column-wise and sets `self.input_metadata`.
2665        - Replaces NaNs with zeros and updates `self.gene_calc`.
2666        """
2667
2668        obj = self.objects
2669
2670        full_data = pd.DataFrame()
2671        full_metadata = pd.DataFrame()
2672
2673        for ke in obj.keys():
2674            print(ke)
2675
2676            dt, met = load_sparse(path=obj[ke], name=ke)
2677
2678            full_data = pd.concat([full_data, dt], axis=1)
2679            full_metadata = pd.concat([full_metadata, met], axis=0)
2680
2681        full_data[np.isnan(full_data)] = 0
2682
2683        if normalized_data:
2684            self.normalized_data = full_data
2685            self.input_metadata = full_metadata
2686        else:
2687
2688            self.input_data = full_data
2689            self.input_metadata = full_metadata
2690
2691        self.gene_calculation()
2692        self.cells_calculation()

2694    def rename_names(self, mapping: dict, slot: str = "cell_names"):
2695        """
2696        Rename entries in `self.input_metadata[slot]` according to a provided mapping.
2697
2698        Parameters
2699        ----------
2700        mapping : dict
2701            Dictionary with keys 'old_name' and 'new_name', each mapping to a list
2702            of equal length describing replacements.
2703
2704        slot : str, default 'cell_names'
2705            Metadata column to operate on.
2706
2707        Update
2708        -------
2709        Updates `self.input_metadata[slot]` in-place with renamed values.
2710
2711        Raises
2712        ------
2713        ValueError
2714            If mapping keys are incorrect, lengths differ, or some 'old_name' values
2715            are not present in the metadata column.
2716        """
2717
2718        if set(["old_name", "new_name"]) != set(mapping.keys()):
2719            raise ValueError(
2720                "Mapping dictionary must contain keys 'old_name' and 'new_name', "
2721                "each with a list of names to change."
2722            )
2723
2724        if len(mapping["old_name"]) != len(mapping["new_name"]):
2725            raise ValueError(
2726                "Mapping dictionary lists 'old_name' and 'new_name' "
2727                "must have the same length!"
2728            )
2729
2730        names_vector = list(self.input_metadata[slot])
2731
2732        if not all(elem in names_vector for elem in list(mapping["old_name"])):
2733            raise ValueError(
2734                f"Some entries from 'old_name' do not exist in the names of slot {slot}."
2735            )
2736
2737        replace_dict = dict(zip(mapping["old_name"], mapping["new_name"]))
2738
2739        names_vector_ret = [replace_dict.get(item, item) for item in names_vector]
2740
2741        self.input_metadata[slot] = names_vector_ret
2742

2755
2756        Raises

2761
2762        if set(["old_name", "new_name"]) != set(mapping.keys()):
2763            raise ValueError(
2764                "Mapping dictionary must contain keys 'old_name' and 'new_name', "
2765                "each with a list of names to change."
2766            )

2768        if len(mapping["old_name"]) != len(mapping["new_name"]):
2769            raise ValueError(

2774        names_vector = list(self.subclusters_.subclusters)

2787    def save_sparse(
2788        self,
2789        path_to_save: str = os.getcwd(),
2790        name_slot: str = "cell_names",
2791        data_slot: str = "normalized",
2792    ):
2793        """
2794        Export data as 10x-compatible sparse files (matrix.mtx, barcodes.tsv, genes.tsv).
2795
2796        Parameters
2797        ----------
2798        path_to_save : str, default current working directory
2799            Directory where files will be written.
2800
2801        name_slot : str, default 'cell_names'
2802            Metadata column providing cell names for barcodes.tsv.
2803
2804        data_slot : str, default 'normalized'
2805            Either 'normalized' (uses self.normalized_data) or 'count' (uses self.input_data).
2806
2807        Raises
2808        ------
2809        ValueError
2810            If `data_slot` is not 'normalized' or 'count'.
2811        """
2812
2813        names = self.input_metadata[name_slot]
2814
2815        if data_slot.lower() == "normalized":
2816
2817            features = list(self.normalized_data.index)
2818            mtx = sparse.csr_matrix(self.normalized_data)
2819
2820        elif data_slot.lower() == "count":
2821
2822            features = list(self.input_data.index)

2826            raise ValueError("'data_slot' must be included in 'normalized' or 'count'")
2827
2828        os.makedirs(path_to_save, exist_ok=True)
2829
2830        mmwrite(os.path.join(path_to_save, "matrix.mtx"), mtx)

2835            header=False,
2836            sep="\t",
2837        )

2840            os.path.join(path_to_save, "genes.tsv"), index=False, header=False, sep="\t"
2841        )

2843    def normalize_counts(
2844        self, normalize_factor: int = 100000, log_transform: bool = True
2845    ):
2846        """
2847        Normalize raw counts to counts-per-(normalize_factor)
2848        (e.g., CPM, TPM - depending on normalize_factor).
2849
2850        Parameters
2851        ----------
2852        normalize_factor : int, default 100000
2853            Scaling factor used after dividing by column sums.
2854
2855        log_transform : bool, default True
2856            If True, apply log2(x+1) transformation to normalized values.
2857
2858        Update
2859        -------
2860            Sets `self.normalized_data` to normalized values (fills NaNs with 0).
2861
2862        Raises
2863        ------
2864        ValueError
2865            If `self.input_data` is missing (cannot normalize).
2866        """
2867        if self.input_data is None:
2868            raise ValueError("Input data is missing, cannot normalize.")
2869
2870        sum_col = self.input_data.sum()
2871        self.normalized_data = self.input_data.div(sum_col).fillna(0) * normalize_factor
2872
2873        if log_transform:
2874            # log2(x + 1) to avoid -inf for zeros
2875            self.normalized_data = np.log2(self.normalized_data + 1)
2876
2877    def statistic(
2878        self,
2879        cells=None,
2880        sets=None,
2881        with_sets_names: bool = False,
2882        min_exp: float = 0.01,
2883        min_pct: float = 0.1,
2884        n_proc: int = 10,
2885    ):
2886        """
2887        Compute per-feature statistics (Mann–Whitney U) comparing target vs rest.
2888
2889        This is a wrapper similar to `calc_DEG` tailored to use `self.normalized_data`
2890        and `self.input_metadata`. It returns per-feature statistics including p-values,
2891        adjusted p-values, means, variances, effect-size measures and fold-changes.
2892
2893        Parameters
2894        ----------
2895        cells : list, 'All', dict, or None
2896            Defines the target cells or groups for comparison (several modes supported).
2897
2898        sets : 'All', dict, or None
2899            Alternative grouping mode (operate on `self.input_metadata['sets']`).
2900
2901        min_exp : float, default 0.01
2902            Minimum expression threshold used when filtering features.
2903
2904        min_pct : float, default 0.1
2905            Minimum proportion of expressing cells in the target group required to test a feature.
2906
2907        n_proc : int, default 10
2908            Number of parallel jobs to use.
2909
2910        Returns
2911        -------
2912        pandas.DataFrame or dict
2913            Results DataFrame (or dict containing valid/control cells + DataFrame),
2914            similar to `calc_DEG` interface.
2915
2916        Raises
2917        ------
2918        ValueError
2919            If neither `cells` nor `sets` is provided, or input metadata mismatch occurs.
2920
2921        Notes
2922        -----
2923        Multiple modes supported: single-list entities, 'All', pairwise dicts, etc.
2924        """
2925
2926        offset = 1e-100
2927
2928        def stat_calc(choose, feature_name):
2929            target_values = choose.loc[choose["DEG"] == "target", feature_name]
2930            rest_values = choose.loc[choose["DEG"] == "rest", feature_name]
2931
2932            pct_valid = (target_values > 0).sum() / len(target_values)
2933            pct_rest = (rest_values > 0).sum() / len(rest_values)
2934
2935            avg_valid = np.mean(target_values)
2936            avg_ctrl = np.mean(rest_values)
2937            sd_valid = np.std(target_values, ddof=1)
2938            sd_ctrl = np.std(rest_values, ddof=1)
2939            esm = (avg_valid - avg_ctrl) / np.sqrt(((sd_valid**2 + sd_ctrl**2) / 2))
2940
2941            if np.sum(target_values) == np.sum(rest_values):
2942                p_val = 1.0
2943            else:
2944                _, p_val = stats.mannwhitneyu(
2945                    target_values, rest_values, alternative="two-sided"
2946                )
2947
2948            return {
2949                "feature": feature_name,
2950                "p_val": p_val,
2951                "pct_valid": pct_valid,
2952                "pct_ctrl": pct_rest,
2953                "avg_valid": avg_valid,
2954                "avg_ctrl": avg_ctrl,
2955                "sd_valid": sd_valid,
2956                "sd_ctrl": sd_ctrl,
2957                "esm": esm,
2958            }
2959
2960        def prepare_and_run_stat(choose, valid_group, min_exp, min_pct, n_proc):
2961
2962            def safe_min_half(series):
2963                filtered = series[(series > ((2**-1074) * 2)) & (series.notna())]
2964                return filtered.min() / 2 if not filtered.empty else 0
2965
2966            tmp_dat = choose[choose["DEG"] == "target"]
2967            tmp_dat = tmp_dat.drop("DEG", axis=1)
2968
2969            counts = (tmp_dat > min_exp).sum(axis=0)
2970
2971            total_count = tmp_dat.shape[0]
2972
2973            info = pd.DataFrame(
2974                {"feature": list(tmp_dat.columns), "pct": list(counts / total_count)}
2975            )
2976
2977            del tmp_dat
2978
2979            drop_col = info["feature"][info["pct"] <= min_pct]
2980
2981            if len(drop_col) + 1 == len(choose.columns):
2982                drop_col = info["feature"][info["pct"] == 0]
2983
2984            del info
2985
2986            choose = choose.drop(list(drop_col), axis=1)
2987
2988            results = Parallel(n_jobs=n_proc)(
2989                delayed(stat_calc)(choose, feature)
2990                for feature in tqdm(choose.columns[choose.columns != "DEG"])
2991            )
2992
2993            df = pd.DataFrame(results)
2994            df = df[(df["avg_valid"] > 0) | (df["avg_ctrl"] > 0)]
2995
2996            df["valid_group"] = str(valid_group)
2997            df.sort_values(by="p_val", inplace=True)
2998
2999            num_tests = len(df)
3000            df["adj_pval"] = np.minimum(
3001                1, (df["p_val"] * num_tests) / np.arange(1, num_tests + 1)
3002            )
3003
3004            valid_factor = safe_min_half(df["avg_valid"])
3005            ctrl_factor = safe_min_half(df["avg_ctrl"])
3006
3007            cv_factor = min(valid_factor, ctrl_factor)
3008
3009            if cv_factor == 0:
3010                cv_factor = max(valid_factor, ctrl_factor)
3011
3012            if not np.isfinite(cv_factor) or cv_factor == 0:
3013                cv_factor += offset
3014
3015            valid = df["avg_valid"].where(
3016                df["avg_valid"] != 0, df["avg_valid"] + cv_factor
3017            )
3018            ctrl = df["avg_ctrl"].where(df["avg_ctrl"] != 0, df["avg_ctrl"] + cv_factor)
3019
3020            df["FC"] = valid / ctrl
3021
3022            df["log(FC)"] = np.log2(df["FC"])
3023            df["norm_diff"] = df["avg_valid"] - df["avg_ctrl"]
3024
3025            return df
3026
3027        choose = self.normalized_data.copy().T
3028
3029        final_results = []
3030
3031        if isinstance(cells, list) and sets is None:
3032            print("\nAnalysis started...\nComparing selected cells to the whole set...")
3033            choose.index = (
3034                self.input_metadata["cell_names"] + " # " + self.input_metadata["sets"]
3035            )
3036
3037            if "#" not in cells[0]:
3038                choose.index = self.input_metadata["cell_names"]
3039
3040                print(
3041                    "Not include the set info (name # set) in the 'cells' list. "
3042                    "Only the names will be compared, without considering the set information."
3043                )
3044
3045            labels = ["target" if idx in cells else "rest" for idx in choose.index]
3046            valid = list(
3047                set(choose.index[[i for i, x in enumerate(labels) if x == "target"]])
3048            )
3049
3050            choose["DEG"] = labels
3051            choose = choose[choose["DEG"] != "drop"]
3052
3053            result_df = prepare_and_run_stat(
3054                choose.reset_index(drop=True),
3055                valid_group=valid,
3056                min_exp=min_exp,
3057                min_pct=min_pct,
3058                n_proc=n_proc,
3059            )
3060            return {"valid_cells": valid, "control_cells": "rest", "DEG": result_df}
3061
3062        elif cells == "All" and sets is None:
3063            print("\nAnalysis started...\nComparing each type of cell to others...")
3064
3065            if with_sets_names:
3066                choose.index = (
3067                    self.input_metadata["cell_names"]
3068                    + " # "
3069                    + self.input_metadata["sets"]
3070                )
3071            else:
3072                choose.index = self.input_metadata["cell_names"]
3073
3074            unique_labels = set(choose.index)
3075
3076            for label in tqdm(unique_labels):
3077                print(f"\nCalculating statistics for {label}")
3078                labels = ["target" if idx == label else "rest" for idx in choose.index]
3079                choose["DEG"] = labels
3080                choose = choose[choose["DEG"] != "drop"]
3081                result_df = prepare_and_run_stat(
3082                    choose.copy(),
3083                    valid_group=label,
3084                    min_exp=min_exp,
3085                    min_pct=min_pct,
3086                    n_proc=n_proc,
3087                )
3088                final_results.append(result_df)
3089
3090            return pd.concat(final_results, ignore_index=True)
3091
3092        elif cells is None and sets == "All":
3093            print("\nAnalysis started...\nComparing each set/group to others...")
3094            choose.index = self.input_metadata["sets"]
3095            unique_sets = set(choose.index)
3096
3097            for label in tqdm(unique_sets):
3098                print(f"\nCalculating statistics for {label}")
3099                labels = ["target" if idx == label else "rest" for idx in choose.index]
3100
3101                choose["DEG"] = labels
3102                choose = choose[choose["DEG"] != "drop"]
3103                result_df = prepare_and_run_stat(
3104                    choose.copy(),
3105                    valid_group=label,
3106                    min_exp=min_exp,
3107                    min_pct=min_pct,
3108                    n_proc=n_proc,
3109                )
3110                final_results.append(result_df)
3111
3112            return pd.concat(final_results, ignore_index=True)
3113
3114        elif cells is None and isinstance(sets, dict):
3115            print("\nAnalysis started...\nComparing groups...")
3116
3117            choose.index = self.input_metadata["sets"]
3118
3119            group_list = list(sets.keys())
3120            if len(group_list) != 2:
3121                print("Only pairwise group comparison is supported.")
3122                return None
3123
3124            labels = [
3125                (
3126                    "target"
3127                    if idx in sets[group_list[0]]
3128                    else "rest" if idx in sets[group_list[1]] else "drop"
3129                )
3130                for idx in choose.index
3131            ]
3132            choose["DEG"] = labels
3133            choose = choose[choose["DEG"] != "drop"]
3134
3135            result_df = prepare_and_run_stat(
3136                choose.reset_index(drop=True),
3137                valid_group=group_list[0],
3138                min_exp=min_exp,
3139                min_pct=min_pct,
3140                n_proc=n_proc,
3141            )
3142            return result_df
3143
3144        elif isinstance(cells, dict) and sets is None:
3145            print("\nAnalysis started...\nComparing groups...")
3146            choose.index = (
3147                self.input_metadata["cell_names"] + " # " + self.input_metadata["sets"]
3148            )
3149
3150            if "#" not in cells[list(cells.keys())[0]][0]:
3151                choose.index = self.input_metadata["cell_names"]
3152
3153                print(
3154                    "Not include the set info (name # set) in the 'cells' dict. "
3155                    "Only the names will be compared, without considering the set information."
3156                )
3157
3158            group_list = list(cells.keys())
3159            if len(group_list) != 2:
3160                print("Only pairwise group comparison is supported.")
3161                return None
3162
3163            labels = [
3164                (
3165                    "target"
3166                    if idx in cells[group_list[0]]
3167                    else "rest" if idx in cells[group_list[1]] else "drop"
3168                )
3169                for idx in choose.index
3170            ]
3171
3172            choose["DEG"] = labels
3173            choose = choose[choose["DEG"] != "drop"]
3174
3175            result_df = prepare_and_run_stat(
3176                choose.reset_index(drop=True),
3177                valid_group=group_list[0],
3178                min_exp=min_exp,
3179                min_pct=min_pct,
3180                n_proc=n_proc,
3181            )
3182
3183            return result_df.reset_index(drop=True)
3184
3185        else:
3186            raise ValueError(
3187                "You must specify either 'cells' or 'sets' (or both). None were provided, which is not allowed for this analysis."
3188            )
3189
3190    def calculate_difference_markers(
3191        self, min_exp=0, min_pct=0.25, n_proc=10, force: bool = False
3192    ):
3193        """
3194        Compute differential markers (var_data) if not already present.
3195
3196        Parameters
3197        ----------
3198        min_exp : float, default 0
3199            Minimum expression threshold passed to `statistic`.
3200
3201        min_pct : float, default 0.25
3202            Minimum percent expressed in target group.
3203
3204        n_proc : int, default 10
3205            Parallel jobs.
3206
3207        force : bool, default False
3208            If True, recompute even if `self.var_data` is present.
3209
3210        Update
3211        -------
3212        Sets `self.var_data` to the result of `self.statistic(...)`.
3213
3214        Raise
3215        ------
3216        ValueError if already computed and `force` is False.
3217        """
3218
3219        if self.var_data is None or force:
3220
3221            self.var_data = self.statistic(
3222                cells="All", sets=None, min_exp=min_exp, min_pct=min_pct, n_proc=n_proc
3223            )
3224
3225        else:
3226            raise ValueError(
3227                "self.calculate_difference_markers() has already been executed. "
3228                "The results are stored in self.var. "
3229                "If you want to recalculate with different statistics, please rerun the method with force=True."
3230            )
3231
3232    def clustering_features(
3233        self,
3234        features_list: list | None,
3235        name_slot: str = "cell_names",
3236        p_val: float = 0.05,
3237        top_n: int = 25,
3238        adj_mean: bool = True,
3239        beta: float = 0.2,
3240    ):
3241        """
3242        Prepare clustering input by selecting marker features and optionally smoothing cell values
3243        toward group means.
3244
3245        Parameters
3246        ----------
3247        features_list : list or None
3248            If provided, use this list of features. If None, features are selected
3249            from `self.var_data` (adj_pval <= p_val, positive logFC) picking `top_n` per group.
3250
3251        name_slot : str, default 'cell_names'
3252            Metadata column used for naming.
3253
3254        p_val : float, default 0.05
3255            Adjusted p-value cutoff when selecting features automatically.
3256
3257        top_n : int, default 25
3258            Number of top features per valid group to keep if `features_list` is None.
3259
3260        adj_mean : bool, default True
3261            If True, adjust cell values toward group means using `beta`.
3262
3263        beta : float, default 0.2
3264            Adjustment strength toward group mean.
3265
3266        Update
3267        ------
3268        Sets `self.clustering_data` and `self.clustering_metadata` to the selected subset,
3269        ready for PCA/UMAP/clustering.
3270        """
3271
3272        if features_list is None or len(features_list) == 0:
3273
3274            if self.var_data is None:
3275                raise ValueError(
3276                    "Lack of 'self.var_data'. Use self.calculate_difference_markers() method first."
3277                )
3278
3279            df_tmp = self.var_data[self.var_data["adj_pval"] <= p_val]
3280            df_tmp = df_tmp[df_tmp["log(FC)"] > 0]
3281            df_tmp = (
3282                df_tmp.sort_values(
3283                    ["valid_group", "esm", "log(FC)"], ascending=[True, False, False]
3284                )
3285                .groupby("valid_group")
3286                .head(top_n)
3287            )
3288
3289            feaures_list = list(set(df_tmp["feature"]))
3290
3291        data = self.get_partial_data(
3292            names=None, features=feaures_list, name_slot=name_slot
3293        )
3294        data_avg = average(data)
3295
3296        if adj_mean:
3297            data = adjust_cells_to_group_mean(data=data, data_avg=data_avg, beta=beta)
3298
3299        self.clustering_data = data
3300
3301        self.clustering_metadata = self.input_metadata
3302
3303    def average(self):
3304        """
3305        Aggregate normalized data by (cell_name, set) pairs computing the mean per group.
3306
3307        The method constructs new column names as "cell_name # set", averages columns
3308        sharing identical labels, and populates `self.agg_normalized_data` and `self.agg_metadata`.
3309
3310        Update
3311        ------
3312        Sets `self.agg_normalized_data` (features x aggregated samples) and
3313        `self.agg_metadata` (DataFrame with 'cell_names' and 'sets').
3314        """
3315
3316        wide_data = self.normalized_data
3317
3318        wide_metadata = self.input_metadata
3319
3320        new_names = wide_metadata["cell_names"] + " # " + wide_metadata["sets"]
3321
3322        wide_data.columns = list(new_names)
3323
3324        aggregated_df = wide_data.T.groupby(level=0).mean().T
3325
3326        sets = [re.sub(".*# ", "", x) for x in aggregated_df.columns]
3327        names = [re.sub(" #.*", "", x) for x in aggregated_df.columns]
3328
3329        aggregated_df.columns = names
3330        aggregated_metadata = pd.DataFrame({"cell_names": names, "sets": sets})
3331
3332        self.agg_metadata = aggregated_metadata
3333        self.agg_normalized_data = aggregated_df
3334
3335    def estimating_similarity(
3336        self, method="pearson", p_val: float = 0.05, top_n: int = 25
3337    ):
3338        """
3339        Estimate pairwise similarity and Euclidean distance between aggregated samples.
3340
3341        Parameters
3342        ----------
3343        method : str, default 'pearson'
3344            Correlation method to use (passed to pandas.DataFrame.corr()).
3345
3346        p_val : float, default 0.05
3347            Adjusted p-value cutoff used to select marker features from `self.var_data`.
3348
3349        top_n : int, default 25
3350            Number of top features per valid group to include.
3351
3352        Update
3353        -------
3354        Computes a combined table with per-pair correlation and euclidean distance
3355        and stores it in `self.similarity`.
3356        """
3357
3358        if self.var_data is None:
3359            raise ValueError(
3360                "Lack of 'self.var_data'. Use self.calculate_difference_markers() method first."
3361            )
3362
3363        self.average()
3364        metadata = self.agg_metadata
3365        data = self.agg_normalized_data
3366
3367        df_tmp = self.var_data[self.var_data["adj_pval"] <= p_val]
3368        df_tmp = df_tmp[df_tmp["log(FC)"] > 0]
3369        df_tmp = (
3370            df_tmp.sort_values(
3371                ["valid_group", "esm", "log(FC)"], ascending=[True, False, False]
3372            )
3373            .groupby("valid_group")
3374            .head(top_n)
3375        )
3376
3377        data = data.loc[list(set(df_tmp["feature"]))]
3378
3379        if len(set(metadata["sets"])) > 1:
3380            data.columns = data.columns + " # " + [x for x in metadata["sets"]]
3381        else:
3382            data = data.copy()
3383
3384        scaler = StandardScaler()
3385
3386        scaled_data = scaler.fit_transform(data)
3387
3388        scaled_df = pd.DataFrame(scaled_data, columns=data.columns)
3389
3390        cor = scaled_df.corr(method=method)
3391        cor_df = cor.stack().reset_index()
3392        cor_df.columns = ["cell1", "cell2", "correlation"]
3393
3394        distances = pdist(scaled_df.T, metric="euclidean")
3395        dist_mat = pd.DataFrame(
3396            squareform(distances), index=scaled_df.columns, columns=scaled_df.columns
3397        )
3398        dist_df = dist_mat.stack().reset_index()
3399        dist_df.columns = ["cell1", "cell2", "euclidean_dist"]
3400
3401        full = pd.merge(cor_df, dist_df, on=["cell1", "cell2"])
3402
3403        full = full[full["cell1"] != full["cell2"]]
3404        full = full.reset_index(drop=True)
3405
3406        self.similarity = full
3407
3408    def similarity_plot(
3409        self,
3410        split_sets=True,
3411        set_info: bool = True,
3412        cmap="seismic",
3413        width=12,
3414        height=10,
3415    ):
3416        """
3417        Visualize similarity as a dot plot.
3418
3419        Parameters
3420        ----------
3421        split_sets : bool, default True
3422            If True and set information is present, split plotting area roughly into two halves to visualize cross-set pairs.
3423
3424        set_info : bool, default True
3425            If True, keep the ' # set' annotation in labels; otherwise strip it.
3426
3427        cmap : str, default 'seismic'
3428            Color map for correlation (hue).
3429
3430        width : int, default 12
3431            Figure width.
3432
3433        height : int, default 10
3434            Figure height.
3435
3436        Returns
3437        -------
3438        matplotlib.figure.Figure
3439
3440        Raises
3441        ------
3442        ValueError
3443            If `self.similarity` is None.
3444
3445        Notes
3446        -----
3447        The function filters pairs by z-scored euclidean distance > 0 to focus on closer pairs.
3448        """
3449
3450        if self.similarity is None:
3451            raise ValueError(
3452                "Similarity data is missing. Please calculate similarity using self.estimating_similarity."
3453            )
3454
3455        similarity_data = self.similarity
3456
3457        if " # " in similarity_data["cell1"][0]:
3458            similarity_data["set1"] = [
3459                re.sub(".*# ", "", x) for x in similarity_data["cell1"]
3460            ]
3461            similarity_data["set2"] = [
3462                re.sub(".*# ", "", x) for x in similarity_data["cell2"]
3463            ]
3464
3465        if split_sets and " # " in similarity_data["cell1"][0]:
3466            sets = list(
3467                set(list(similarity_data["set1"]) + list(similarity_data["set2"]))
3468            )
3469
3470            mm = math.ceil(len(sets) / 2)
3471
3472            x_s = sets[0:mm]
3473            y_s = sets[mm : len(sets)]
3474
3475            similarity_data = similarity_data[similarity_data["set1"].isin(x_s)]
3476            similarity_data = similarity_data[similarity_data["set2"].isin(y_s)]
3477
3478            similarity_data = similarity_data.sort_values(["set1", "set2"])
3479
3480        if set_info is False and " # " in similarity_data["cell1"][0]:
3481            similarity_data["cell1"] = [
3482                re.sub(" #.*", "", x) for x in similarity_data["cell1"]
3483            ]
3484            similarity_data["cell2"] = [
3485                re.sub(" #.*", "", x) for x in similarity_data["cell2"]
3486            ]
3487
3488        similarity_data["-euclidean_zscore"] = -zscore(
3489            similarity_data["euclidean_dist"]
3490        )
3491
3492        similarity_data = similarity_data[similarity_data["-euclidean_zscore"] > 0]
3493
3494        fig = plt.figure(figsize=(width, height))
3495        sns.scatterplot(
3496            data=similarity_data,
3497            x="cell1",
3498            y="cell2",
3499            hue="correlation",
3500            size="-euclidean_zscore",
3501            sizes=(1, 100),
3502            palette=cmap,
3503            alpha=1,
3504            edgecolor="black",
3505        )
3506
3507        plt.xticks(rotation=90)
3508        plt.yticks(rotation=0)
3509        plt.xlabel("Cell 1")
3510        plt.ylabel("Cell 2")
3511        plt.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc="upper left")
3512
3513        plt.grid(True, alpha=0.6)
3514
3515        plt.tight_layout()
3516
3517        return fig
3518
3519    def spatial_similarity(
3520        self,
3521        set_info: bool = True,
3522        bandwidth=1,
3523        n_neighbors=5,
3524        min_dist=0.1,
3525        legend_split=2,
3526        point_size=200,
3527        spread=1.0,
3528        set_op_mix_ratio=1.0,
3529        local_connectivity=1,
3530        repulsion_strength=1.0,
3531        negative_sample_rate=5,
3532        threshold=0.1,
3533        size_sort: bool = True,
3534        width=12,
3535        height=10,
3536    ):
3537        """
3538        Create a spatial UMAP-like visualization of similarity relationships between samples.
3539
3540        Parameters
3541        ----------
3542        set_info : bool, default True
3543            If True, retain set information in labels.
3544
3545        bandwidth : float, default 1
3546            Bandwidth used by MeanShift for clustering polygons.
3547
3548        point_size : float, default 200
3549            Size of scatter points.
3550
3551        legend_split : int, default 2
3552            Number of columns in legend.
3553
3554        n_neighbors, min_dist, spread, set_op_mix_ratio, local_connectivity, repulsion_strength, negative_sample_rate : parameters passed to UMAP.
3555
3556        threshold : float, default 0.1
3557            Minimum text distance for label adjustment to avoid overlap.
3558
3559        size_sort : bool, default=True
3560            If True, cluster names are sorted in descending order by cluster size.
3561             If False, cluster names follow the order of their first appearance in `names_slot`.
3562
3563        width : int, default 12
3564            Figure width.
3565
3566        height : int, default 10
3567            Figure height.
3568
3569        Returns
3570        -------
3571        matplotlib.figure.Figure
3572
3573        Raises
3574        ------
3575        ValueError
3576            If `self.similarity` is None.
3577
3578        Notes
3579        -----
3580        Builds a precomputed distance matrix combining correlation and euclidean distance,
3581        runs UMAP with metric='precomputed', then overlays cluster hulls (MeanShift + convex hull)
3582        and arrows to indicate nearest neighbors (minimal combined distance).
3583        """
3584
3585        if self.similarity is None:
3586            raise ValueError(
3587                "Similarity data is missing. Please calculate similarity using self.estimating_similarity."
3588            )
3589
3590        similarity_data = self.similarity
3591
3592        sim = similarity_data["correlation"]
3593        sim_scaled = (sim - sim.min()) / (sim.max() - sim.min())
3594        eu_dist = similarity_data["euclidean_dist"]
3595        eu_dist_scaled = (eu_dist - eu_dist.min()) / (eu_dist.max() - eu_dist.min())
3596
3597        similarity_data["combo_dist"] = (1 - sim_scaled) * eu_dist_scaled
3598
3599        # for nn target
3600        arrow_df = similarity_data.copy()
3601        arrow_df = similarity_data.loc[
3602            similarity_data.groupby("cell1")["combo_dist"].idxmin()
3603        ]
3604
3605        cells = sorted(set(similarity_data["cell1"]) | set(similarity_data["cell2"]))
3606        combo_matrix = pd.DataFrame(0, index=cells, columns=cells, dtype=float)
3607
3608        for _, row in similarity_data.iterrows():
3609            combo_matrix.loc[row["cell1"], row["cell2"]] = row["combo_dist"]
3610            combo_matrix.loc[row["cell2"], row["cell1"]] = row["combo_dist"]
3611
3612        tmp_data = self.input_metadata.copy()
3613
3614        tmp_data["tmp_nam"] = list(tmp_data["cell_names"] + " # " + tmp_data["sets"])
3615
3616        tmp_data["count"] = tmp_data["tmp_nam"].map(tmp_data["tmp_nam"].value_counts())
3617
3618        tmp_data = pd.DataFrame(tmp_data[["count", "tmp_nam"]].copy()).drop_duplicates()
3619
3620        queue = pd.unique(tmp_data["tmp_nam"])
3621
3622        tmp_data["tmp_nam"] = pd.Categorical(
3623            tmp_data["tmp_nam"], categories=queue, ordered=True
3624        )
3625
3626        if size_sort:
3627            tmp_data = tmp_data.sort_values("count", ascending=False).reset_index(
3628                drop=True
3629            )
3630            tmp_data["id_vec"] = pd.factorize(tmp_data["count"])[0]
3631
3632        else:
3633
3634            tmp_data = tmp_data.sort_values("tmp_nam").reset_index(drop=True)
3635            tmp_data["id_vec"] = pd.factorize(tmp_data["tmp_nam"])[0]
3636
3637        umap_model = umap.UMAP(
3638            n_components=2,
3639            metric="precomputed",
3640            n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
3641            min_dist=min_dist,
3642            spread=spread,
3643            set_op_mix_ratio=set_op_mix_ratio,
3644            local_connectivity=local_connectivity,
3645            repulsion_strength=repulsion_strength,
3646            negative_sample_rate=negative_sample_rate,
3647            transform_seed=42,
3648            init="spectral",
3649            random_state=42,
3650            verbose=True,
3651        )
3652
3653        coords = pd.DataFrame(umap_model.fit_transform(combo_matrix.values))
3654        coords.index = list(combo_matrix.index)
3655        coords = np.array(coords.loc[tmp_data["tmp_nam"].values, :])
3656
3657        cell_names = list(tmp_data["tmp_nam"].values)
3658        num_cells = len(cell_names)
3659        palette = sns.color_palette("tab20c", num_cells)
3660
3661        if "#" in cell_names[0]:
3662            avsets = set(
3663                [re.sub(".*# ", "", x) for x in similarity_data["cell1"]]
3664                + [re.sub(".*# ", "", x) for x in similarity_data["cell2"]]
3665            )
3666            num_sets = len(avsets)
3667            color_indices = [i * len(palette) // num_sets for i in range(num_sets)]
3668            color_mapping_sets = {
3669                set_name: palette[i] for i, set_name in zip(color_indices, avsets)
3670            }
3671            color_mapping = {
3672                name: color_mapping_sets[re.sub(".*# ", "", name)]
3673                for i, name in enumerate(cell_names)
3674            }
3675        else:
3676            color_mapping = {name: palette[i] for i, name in enumerate(cell_names)}
3677
3678        meanshift = MeanShift(bandwidth=bandwidth)
3679        labels = meanshift.fit_predict(coords)
3680
3681        fig = plt.figure(figsize=(width, height))
3682        ax = plt.gca()
3683
3684        unique_labels = set(labels)
3685        cluster_palette = sns.color_palette("hls", len(unique_labels))
3686
3687        for label in unique_labels:
3688            if label == -1:
3689                continue
3690            cluster_coords = coords[labels == label]
3691            if len(cluster_coords) < 3:
3692                continue
3693
3694            hull = ConvexHull(cluster_coords)
3695            hull_points = cluster_coords[hull.vertices]
3696
3697            centroid = np.mean(hull_points, axis=0)
3698            expanded = hull_points + 0.05 * (hull_points - centroid)
3699
3700            poly = Polygon(
3701                expanded,
3702                closed=True,
3703                facecolor=cluster_palette[label],
3704                edgecolor="none",
3705                alpha=0.2,
3706                zorder=1,
3707            )
3708            ax.add_patch(poly)
3709
3710        texts = []
3711        for i, (x, y) in enumerate(coords):
3712            plt.scatter(
3713                x,
3714                y,
3715                s=point_size,
3716                color=color_mapping[cell_names[i]],
3717                edgecolors="black",
3718                linewidths=0.5,
3719                zorder=2,
3720            )
3721            texts.append(
3722                ax.text(
3723                    x, y, str(i), ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="black"
3724                )
3725            )
3726
3727        def dist(p1, p2):
3728            return np.sqrt((p1[0] - p2[0]) ** 2 + (p1[1] - p2[1]) ** 2)
3729
3730        texts_to_adjust = []
3731        for i, t1 in enumerate(texts):
3732            for j, t2 in enumerate(texts):
3733                if i >= j:
3734                    continue
3735                d = dist(
3736                    (t1.get_position()[0], t1.get_position()[1]),
3737                    (t2.get_position()[0], t2.get_position()[1]),
3738                )
3739                if d < threshold:
3740                    if t1 not in texts_to_adjust:
3741                        texts_to_adjust.append(t1)
3742                    if t2 not in texts_to_adjust:
3743                        texts_to_adjust.append(t2)
3744
3745        adjust_text(
3746            texts_to_adjust,
3747            expand_text=(1.0, 1.0),
3748            force_text=0.9,
3749            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", color="gray", lw=0.1),
3750            ax=ax,
3751        )
3752
3753        for _, row in arrow_df.iterrows():
3754            try:
3755                idx1 = cell_names.index(row["cell1"])
3756                idx2 = cell_names.index(row["cell2"])
3757            except ValueError:
3758                continue
3759            x1, y1 = coords[idx1]
3760            x2, y2 = coords[idx2]
3761            arrow = FancyArrowPatch(
3762                (x1, y1),
3763                (x2, y2),
3764                arrowstyle="->",
3765                color="gray",
3766                linewidth=1.5,
3767                alpha=0.5,
3768                mutation_scale=12,
3769                zorder=0,
3770            )
3771            ax.add_patch(arrow)
3772
3773        set_names = set([re.sub(r".*# ", "", x) for x in cell_names])
3774
3775        sets = []
3776        for ic in set_names:
3777            sets.append([x for x in cell_names if ic in x][0])
3778
3779        legend_elements = [
3780            Patch(
3781                facecolor=color_mapping[name],
3782                edgecolor="black",
3783                label=f"{i} – {re.sub(' #.*', '', name)}",
3784            )
3785            for i, name in enumerate(cell_names)
3786        ]
3787
3788        if set_info is True and len(sets) > 1:
3789
3790            for ds in sets:
3791                proxy_marker = Line2D(
3792                    [0],
3793                    [0],
3794                    marker="o",
3795                    color="w",
3796                    markersize=12,
3797                    markerfacecolor=color_mapping[ds],
3798                    markeredgecolor="black",
3799                    linestyle="None",
3800                    label=f"Data: {re.sub(r'.*# ', '', ds)}",
3801                )
3802                legend_elements.append(proxy_marker)
3803
3804        plt.legend(
3805            handles=legend_elements,
3806            title="",
3807            bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1),
3808            loc="upper left",
3809            ncol=legend_split,
3810        )
3811
3812        plt.xlabel("UMAP 1")
3813        plt.ylabel("UMAP 2")
3814        plt.grid(False)
3815        plt.show()
3816
3817        return fig

3821    def subcluster_prepare(self, features: list, cluster: str):
3822        """
3823        Prepare a `Clustering` object for subcluster analysis on a selected parent cluster.
3824
3825        Parameters
3826        ----------
3827        features : list
3828            Features to include for subcluster analysis.
3829
3830        cluster : str
3831            Parent cluster name (used to select matching cells).
3832
3833        Update
3834        ------
3835        Initializes `self.subclusters_` as a new `Clustering` instance containing the
3836        reduced data for the given cluster and stores `current_features` and `current_cluster`.
3837        """
3838
3839        dat = self.normalized_data
3840        dat.columns = list(self.input_metadata["cell_names"])
3841
3842        dat = reduce_data(self.normalized_data, features=features, names=[cluster])
3843
3844        self.subclusters_ = Clustering(data=dat, metadata=None)
3845
3846        self.subclusters_.current_features = features
3847        self.subclusters_.current_cluster = cluster
3848
3849    def define_subclusters(
3850        self,
3851        umap_num: int = 2,
3852        eps: float = 0.5,
3853        min_samples: int = 10,
3854        n_neighbors: int = 5,
3855        min_dist: float = 0.1,
3856        spread: float = 1.0,
3857        set_op_mix_ratio: float = 1.0,
3858        local_connectivity: int = 1,
3859        repulsion_strength: float = 1.0,
3860        negative_sample_rate: int = 5,
3861        width=8,
3862        height=6,
3863    ):
3864        """
3865        Compute UMAP and DBSCAN clustering within a previously prepared subcluster dataset.
3866
3867        Parameters
3868        ----------
3869        umap_num : int, default 2
3870            Number of UMAP dimensions to compute.
3871
3872        eps : float, default 0.5
3873            DBSCAN eps parameter.
3874
3875        min_samples : int, default 10
3876            DBSCAN min_samples parameter.
3877
3878        n_neighbors, min_dist, spread, set_op_mix_ratio, local_connectivity, repulsion_strength, negative_sample_rate, width, height :
3879            Additional parameters passed to UMAP / plotting / MeanShift as appropriate.
3880
3881        Update
3882        -------
3883        Stores cluster labels in `self.subclusters_.subclusters`.
3884
3885        Raises
3886        ------
3887        RuntimeError
3888            If `self.subclusters_` has not been prepared.
3889        """
3890
3891        if self.subclusters_ is None:
3892            raise RuntimeError(
3893                "Nothing to return. 'self.subcluster_prepare' was not conducted!"
3894            )
3895
3896        self.subclusters_.perform_UMAP(
3897            factorize=False,
3898            umap_num=umap_num,
3899            pc_num=0,
3900            harmonized=False,
3901            n_neighbors=n_neighbors,
3902            min_dist=min_dist,
3903            spread=spread,
3904            set_op_mix_ratio=set_op_mix_ratio,
3905            local_connectivity=local_connectivity,
3906            repulsion_strength=repulsion_strength,
3907            negative_sample_rate=negative_sample_rate,
3908            width=width,
3909            height=height,
3910        )
3911
3912        fig = self.subclusters_.find_clusters_UMAP(
3913            umap_n=umap_num,
3914            eps=eps,
3915            min_samples=min_samples,
3916            width=width,
3917            height=height,
3918        )
3919
3920        clusters = self.subclusters_.return_clusters(clusters="umap")
3921
3922        self.subclusters_.subclusters = [str(x) for x in list(clusters)]
3923
3924        return fig

3926    def subcluster_features_dot(
3927        self,
3928        colors="viridis",
3929        hclust="complete",
3930        scale=False,
3931        scale_axis: Literal["x", "y"] = "y",
3932        img_width=3,
3933        img_high=5,
3934        label_size=6,
3935        size_scale=70,
3936        y_lab="Genes",
3937        legend_lab="normalized",
3938        bbox_to_anchor_scale: int = 25,
3939        bbox_to_anchor_perc: tuple = (0.91, 0.63),
3940    ):
3941        """
3942        Create a features-dot visualization for the subclusters (averaged and occurrence).
3943
3944        Parameters
3945        ----------
3946        colors : str, default 'viridis'
3947            Colormap name passed to `features_dot`.
3948
3949        hclust : str or None
3950            Hierarchical clustering linkage to order rows/columns.
3951
3952        scale: bool, default False
3953            If True, expression data will be scaled (0–1) across the rows (features).
3954
3955        scale_axis : {'x', 'y'}, default 'y'
3956            The axis along which to scale the expression data to the [0, 1] range:
3957            - 'y': Scales across columns (per sample / cell).
3958            - 'x': Scales across rows (per feature / gene).
3959            Only effective if `scale=True`.
3960
3961        img_width, img_high : float
3962            Figure size.
3963
3964        label_size : int
3965            Font size for labels.
3966
3967        size_scale : int
3968            Bubble size scaling.
3969
3970        y_lab : str
3971            X axis label.
3972
3973        legend_lab : str
3974            Colorbar label.
3975
3976        bbox_to_anchor_scale : int, default=25
3977            Vertical scale (percentage) for positioning the colorbar.
3978
3979        bbox_to_anchor_perc : tuple, default=(0.91, 0.63)
3980            Anchor position for the size legend (percent bubble legend).
3981
3982        Returns
3983        -------
3984        matplotlib.figure.Figure
3985
3986        Raises
3987        ------
3988        RuntimeError
3989            If subcluster preparation/definition has not been run.
3990        """
3991
3992        if self.subclusters_ is None or self.subclusters_.subclusters is None:
3993            raise RuntimeError(
3994                "Nothing to return. 'self.subcluster_prepare' -> 'self.define_subclusters' pip was not conducted!"
3995            )
3996
3997        dat = self.normalized_data
3998        dat.columns = list(self.input_metadata["cell_names"])
3999
4000        dat = reduce_data(
4001            self.normalized_data,
4002            features=self.subclusters_.current_features,
4003            names=[self.subclusters_.current_cluster],
4004        )
4005
4006        dat.columns = self.subclusters_.subclusters
4007
4008        avg = average(dat)
4009        occ = occurrence(dat)
4010
4011        scatter = features_dot(
4012            expression_data=avg,

4032    def subcluster_DEG_dot(
4033        self,
4034        top_n=3,
4035        min_exp=0,
4036        min_pct=0.25,
4037        p_val=0.05,
4038        colors="viridis",
4039        hclust="complete",
4040        scale=False,
4041        scale_axis: Literal["x", "y"] = "y",
4042        img_width=3,
4043        img_high=5,
4044        label_size=6,
4045        size_scale=70,
4046        y_lab="Genes",
4047        legend_lab="normalized",
4048        bbox_to_anchor_scale: int = 25,
4049        bbox_to_anchor_perc: tuple = (0.91, 0.63),
4050        n_proc=10,
4051    ):
4052        """
4053        Plot top differential features (DEGs) for subclusters as a features-dot.
4054
4055        Parameters
4056        ----------
4057        top_n : int, default 3
4058            Number of top features per subcluster to show.
4059
4060        min_exp : float, default 0
4061            Minimum expression threshold passed to `statistic`.
4062
4063        min_pct : float, default 0.25
4064            Minimum percent expressed in target group.
4065
4066        p_val: float, default 0.05
4067            Maximum p-value for visualizing features.
4068
4069        n_proc : int, default 10
4070            Parallel jobs used for DEG calculation.
4071
4072        scale: bool, default False
4073            If True, expression_data will be scaled (0–1) across the rows (features).
4074
4075        scale_axis : {'x', 'y'}, default 'y'
4076            The axis along which to scale the expression data to the [0, 1] range:
4077            - 'y': Scales across columns (per sample / cell).
4078            - 'x': Scales across rows (per feature / gene).
4079            Only effective if `scale=True`.
4080
4081        colors : str, default='viridis'
4082            Colormap for expression values.
4083
4084        hclust : str or None, default='complete'
4085            Linkage method for hierarchical clustering. If None, no clustering
4086            is performed.
4087
4088        img_width : int or float, default=8
4089            Width of the plot in inches.
4090
4091        img_high : int or float, default=5
4092            Height of the plot in inches.
4093
4094        label_size : int, default=10
4095            Font size for axis labels and ticks.
4096
4097        size_scale : int or float, default=100
4098            Scaling factor for bubble sizes.
4099
4100        y_lab : str, default='Genes'
4101            Label for the x-axis.
4102
4103        legend_lab : str, default='normalized'
4104            Label for the colorbar legend.
4105
4106        bbox_to_anchor_scale : int, default=25
4107            Vertical scale (percentage) for positioning the colorbar.
4108
4109        bbox_to_anchor_perc : tuple, default=(0.91, 0.63)
4110            Anchor position for the size legend (percent bubble legend).
4111
4112        Returns
4113        -------
4114        matplotlib.figure.Figure
4115
4116        Raises
4117        ------
4118        RuntimeError
4119            If subcluster preparation/definition has not been run.
4120
4121        Notes
4122        -----
4123        Internally calls `calc_DEG` (or equivalent) to obtain statistics, filters
4124        by p-value and effect-size, selects top features per valid group and plots them.
4125        """
4126
4127        if self.subclusters_ is None or self.subclusters_.subclusters is None:
4128            raise RuntimeError(
4129                "Nothing to return. 'self.subcluster_prepare' -> 'self.define_subclusters' pip was not conducted!"
4130            )
4131
4132        dat = self.normalized_data
4133        dat.columns = list(self.input_metadata["cell_names"])
4134
4135        dat = reduce_data(
4136            self.normalized_data, names=[self.subclusters_.current_cluster]
4137        )
4138
4139        dat.columns = self.subclusters_.subclusters
4140
4141        deg_stats = calc_DEG(
4142            dat,
4143            metadata_list=None,
4144            entities="All",
4145            sets=None,
4146            min_exp=min_exp,
4147            min_pct=min_pct,
4148            n_proc=n_proc,
4149        )
4150
4151        deg_stats = deg_stats[deg_stats["p_val"] <= p_val]
4152        deg_stats = deg_stats[deg_stats["log(FC)"] > 0]
4153
4154        deg_stats = (
4155            deg_stats.sort_values(
4156                ["valid_group", "esm", "log(FC)"], ascending=[True, False, False]
4157            )
4158            .groupby("valid_group")
4159            .head(top_n)
4160        )
4161
4162        dat = reduce_data(dat, features=list(set(deg_stats["feature"])))
4163
4164        avg = average(dat)
4165        occ = occurrence(dat)
4166
4167        scatter = features_dot(
4168            expression_data=avg,
4169            occurence_data=occ,
4170            features=None,
4171            metadata_list=None,
4172            scale_axis=scale_axis,
4173            scale=scale,
4174            colors=colors,
4175            hclust=hclust,
4176            img_width=img_width,
4177            img_high=img_high,
4178            label_size=label_size,
4179            size_scale=size_scale,
4180            y_lab=y_lab,
4181            legend_lab=legend_lab,
4182            bbox_to_anchor_scale=bbox_to_anchor_scale,
4183            bbox_to_anchor_perc=bbox_to_anchor_perc,
4184        )
4185
4186        return scatter
4187
4188    def accept_subclusters(self):
4189        """
4190        Commit subcluster labels into the main `input_metadata` by renaming cell names.
4191
4192        The method replaces occurrences of the parent cluster name in `self.input_metadata['cell_names']`
4193        with the expanded names that include subcluster suffixes (via `add_subnames`),
4194        then clears `self.subclusters_`.
4195
4196        Update
4197        ------
4198        Modifies `self.input_metadata['cell_names']`.
4199
4200        Resets `self.subclusters_` to None.
4201
4202        Raises
4203        ------
4204        RuntimeError
4205            If `self.subclusters_` is not defined or subclusters were not computed.
4206        """
4207
4208        if self.subclusters_ is None or self.subclusters_.subclusters is None:
4209            raise RuntimeError(
4210                "Nothing to return. 'self.subcluster_prepare' -> 'self.define_subclusters' pip was not conducted!"
4211            )
4212
4213        new_meta = add_subnames(
4214            list(self.input_metadata["cell_names"]),
4215            parent_name=self.subclusters_.current_cluster,
4216            new_clusters=self.subclusters_.subclusters,
4217        )
4218
4219        self.input_metadata["cell_names"] = new_meta
4220
4221        if "clustering_metadata" in self.__dict__.keys():
4222            self.clustering_metadata["cell_names"] = new_meta
4223
4224        self.subclusters_ = None

4226    def dot_plot(
4227        self,
4228        names: list | None = None,
4229        features: list | None = None,
4230        name_slot: str = "cell_names",
4231        scale=True,
4232        scale_axis: Literal["x", "y"] = "y",
4233        colors="viridis",
4234        hclust=None,
4235        img_width=15,
4236        img_high=1,
4237        label_size=10,
4238        size_scale=200,
4239        y_lab="Genes",
4240        legend_lab="log(CPM + 1)",
4241        set_box_size: float | int = 5,
4242        set_box_high: float | int = 5,
4243        bbox_to_anchor_scale=25,
4244        bbox_to_anchor_perc=(0.90, -0.24),
4245        bbox_to_anchor_group=(1.01, 0.4),
4246    ):
4247        """
4248        Create a dot plot of selected features across samples inside project.
4249
4250        Each point represents a feature-sample pair, where the color encodes the
4251        expression value and the size encodes occurrence or relative abundance.
4252        Optionally, hierarchical clustering can be applied to order rows and columns.
4253
4254        Parameters
4255        ----------
4256        names : list, str, or None
4257            Names of samples to include. If None, all samples are considered.
4258
4259        features : list, str, or None
4260            Names of features to include. If None, all features are considered.
4261
4262        name_slot : str
4263            Column in metadata to use as sample names.
4264
4265        scale: bool, default False
4266            If True, expression_data will be scaled (0–1) across the rows (features).
4267
4268        scale_axis : {'x', 'y'}, default 'y'
4269            The axis along which to scale the expression data to the [0, 1] range:
4270            - 'y': Scales across columns (per sample / cell).
4271            - 'x': Scales across rows (per feature / gene).
4272            Only effective if `scale=True`.
4273
4274        colors : str, default='viridis'
4275            Colormap for expression values.
4276
4277        hclust : str or None, default='complete'
4278            Linkage method for hierarchical clustering. If None, no clustering
4279            is performed.
4280
4281        img_width : int or float, default=8
4282            Width of the plot in inches.
4283
4284        img_high : int or float, default=5
4285            Height of the plot in inches.
4286
4287        label_size : int, default=10
4288            Font size for axis labels and ticks.
4289
4290        size_scale : int or float, default=100
4291            Scaling factor for bubble sizes.
4292
4293        y_lab : str, default='Genes'
4294            Label for the x-axis.
4295
4296        legend_lab : str, default='log(CPM + 1)'
4297            Label for the colorbar legend.
4298
4299        bbox_to_anchor_scale : int, default=25
4300            Vertical scale (percentage) for positioning the colorbar.
4301
4302        bbox_to_anchor_perc : tuple, default=(0.91, 0.63)
4303            Anchor position for the size legend (percent bubble legend).
4304
4305        bbox_to_anchor_group : tuple, default=(1.01, 0.4)
4306            Anchor position for the group legend.
4307
4308        Returns
4309        -------
4310        matplotlib.figure.Figure
4311            The generated dot plot figure.
4312
4313        Notes
4314        -----
4315        Colors represent expression values normalized to the colormap.
4316        """
4317
4318        prtd, met = self.get_partial_data(
4319            names=names, features=features, name_slot=name_slot, inc_metadata=True
4320        )
4321
4322        prtd.columns = prtd.columns + "#" + met["sets"]
4323
4324        prtd_avg = average(prtd)
4325
4326        meta_sets = [re.sub(".*#", "", x) for x in prtd_avg.columns]
4327
4328        prtd_avg.columns = [re.sub("#.*", "", x) for x in prtd_avg.columns]
4329
4330        prtd_occ = occurrence(prtd)
4331
4332        prtd_occ.columns = [re.sub("#.*", "", x) for x in prtd_occ.columns]
4333
4334        fig_scatter = features_dot(
4335            expression_data=prtd_avg,
4336            occurence_data=prtd_occ,
4337            scale=scale,
4338            scale_axis=scale_axis,
4339            features=None,
4340            metadata_list=meta_sets,
4341            colors=colors,
4342            hclust=hclust,
4343            img_width=img_width,
4344            img_high=img_high,
4345            label_size=label_size,
4346            size_scale=size_scale,
4347            y_lab=y_lab,
4348            legend_lab=legend_lab,
4349            set_box_size=set_box_size,
4350            set_box_high=set_box_high,
4351            bbox_to_anchor_scale=bbox_to_anchor_scale,
4352            bbox_to_anchor_perc=bbox_to_anchor_perc,
4353            bbox_to_anchor_group=bbox_to_anchor_group,
4354        )
4355
4356        return fig_scatter

4358    def data_composition(
4359        self,
4360        features_count: list | None,
4361        name_slot: str = "cell_names",
4362        set_sep: bool = True,
4363    ):
4364        """
4365        Compute composition of cell types in data set.
4366
4367        This function counts the occurrences of specific cells (e.g., cell types, subtypes)
4368        within metadata entries, calculates their relative percentages, and stores
4369        the results in `self.composition_data`.
4370
4371        Parameters
4372        ----------
4373        features_count : list or None
4374            List of features (part or full names) to be counted.
4375            If None, all unique elements from the specified `name_slot` metadata field are used.
4376
4377        name_slot : str, default 'cell_names'
4378            Metadata field containing sample identifiers or labels.
4379
4380        set_sep : bool, default True
4381            If True and multiple sets are present in metadata, compute composition
4382            separately for each set.
4383
4384        Update
4385        -------
4386        Stores results in `self.composition_data` as a pandas DataFrame with:
4387        - 'name': feature name
4388        - 'n': number of occurrences
4389        - 'pct': percentage of occurrences
4390        - 'set' (if applicable): dataset identifier
4391        """
4392
4393        validated_list = list(self.input_metadata[name_slot])
4394        sets = list(self.input_metadata["sets"])
4395
4396        if features_count is None:
4397            features_count = list(set(self.input_metadata[name_slot]))
4398
4399        if set_sep and len(set(sets)) > 1:
4400
4401            final_res = pd.DataFrame()
4402
4403            for s in set(sets):
4404                print(s)
4405
4406                mask = [True if s == x else False for x in sets]
4407
4408                tmp_val_list = np.array(validated_list)
4409
4410                tmp_val_list = list(tmp_val_list[mask])
4411
4412                res_dict = {"name": [], "n": [], "set": []}
4413
4414                for f in tqdm(features_count):
4415                    res_dict["n"].append(
4416                        sum(1 for element in tmp_val_list if f in element)
4417                    )
4418                    res_dict["name"].append(f)
4419                    res_dict["set"].append(s)
4420                    res = pd.DataFrame(res_dict)
4421                    res["pct"] = res["n"] / sum(res["n"]) * 100
4422                    res["pct"] = res["pct"].round(2)
4423
4424                final_res = pd.concat([final_res, res])
4425
4426            res = final_res.sort_values(["set", "pct"], ascending=[True, False])
4427
4428        else:
4429
4430            res_dict = {"name": [], "n": []}
4431
4432            for f in tqdm(features_count):
4433                res_dict["n"].append(
4434                    sum(1 for element in validated_list if f in element)
4435                )
4436                res_dict["name"].append(f)
4437
4438            res = pd.DataFrame(res_dict)
4439            res["pct"] = res["n"] / sum(res["n"]) * 100
4440            res["pct"] = res["pct"].round(2)
4441
4442            res = res.sort_values("pct", ascending=False)
4443
4444        self.composition_data = res
4445
4446    def composition_pie(
4447        self,
4448        width=6,
4449        height=6,
4450        font_size=15,
4451        cmap: str = "tab20",
4452        legend_split_col: int = 1,
4453        offset_labels: float | int = 0.5,
4454        legend_bbox: tuple = (1.15, 0.95),
4455    ):
4456        """
4457        Visualize the composition of cell lineages using pie charts.
4458
4459        Generates pie charts showing the relative proportions of features stored
4460        in `self.composition_data`. If multiple sets are present, a separate
4461        chart is drawn for each set.
4462
4463        Parameters
4464        ----------
4465        width : int, default 6
4466            Width of the figure.
4467
4468        height : int, default 6
4469            Height of the figure (applied per set if multiple sets are plotted).
4470
4471        font_size : int, default 15
4472            Font size for labels and annotations.
4473
4474        cmap : str, default 'tab20'
4475            Colormap used for pie slices.
4476
4477        legend_split_col : int, default 1
4478            Number of columns in the legend.
4479
4480        offset_labels : float or int, default 0.5
4481            Spacing offset for label placement relative to pie slices.
4482
4483        legend_bbox : tuple, default (1.15, 0.95)
4484            Bounding box anchor position for the legend.
4485
4486        Returns
4487        -------
4488        matplotlib.figure.Figure
4489            Pie chart visualization of composition data.
4490        """
4491
4492        df = self.composition_data
4493
4494        if "set" in df.columns and len(set(df["set"])) > 1:
4495
4496            sets = list(set(df["set"]))
4497            fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(sets), 1, figsize=(width, height * len(sets)))
4498
4499            all_wedges = []
4500            cmap = plt.get_cmap(cmap)
4501
4502            set_nam = len(set(df["name"]))
4503
4504            legend_labels = list(set(df["name"]))
4505
4506            colors = [cmap(i / set_nam) for i in range(set_nam)]
4507
4508            cmap_dict = dict(zip(legend_labels, colors))
4509
4510            for idx, s in enumerate(sets):
4511                ax = axes[idx]
4512                tmp_df = df[df["set"] == s].reset_index(drop=True)
4513
4514                labels = [f"{row['pct']:.1f}%" for _, row in tmp_df.iterrows()]
4515
4516                wedges, _ = ax.pie(
4517                    tmp_df["n"],
4518                    startangle=90,
4519                    labeldistance=1.05,
4520                    colors=[cmap_dict[x] for x in tmp_df["name"]],
4521                    wedgeprops={"linewidth": 0.5, "edgecolor": "black"},
4522                )
4523
4524                all_wedges.extend(wedges)
4525
4526                kw = dict(arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-"), zorder=0, va="center")
4527                n = 0
4528                for i, p in enumerate(wedges):
4529                    ang = (p.theta2 - p.theta1) / 2.0 + p.theta1
4530                    y = np.sin(np.deg2rad(ang))
4531                    x = np.cos(np.deg2rad(ang))
4532                    horizontalalignment = {-1: "right", 1: "left"}[int(np.sign(x))]
4533                    connectionstyle = f"angle,angleA=0,angleB={ang}"
4534                    kw["arrowprops"].update({"connectionstyle": connectionstyle})
4535                    if len(labels[i]) > 0:
4536                        n += offset_labels
4537                        ax.annotate(
4538                            labels[i],
4539                            xy=(x, y),
4540                            xytext=(1.01 * x + (n * x / 4), 1.01 * y + (n * y / 4)),
4541                            horizontalalignment=horizontalalignment,
4542                            fontsize=font_size,
4543                            weight="bold",
4544                            **kw,
4545                        )
4546
4547                circle2 = plt.Circle((0, 0), 0.6, color="white", ec="black")
4548                ax.add_artist(circle2)
4549
4550                ax.text(
4551                    0,
4552                    0,
4553                    f"{s}",
4554                    ha="center",
4555                    va="center",
4556                    fontsize=font_size,
4557                    weight="bold",
4558                )
4559
4560            legend_handles = [
4561                Patch(facecolor=cmap_dict[label], edgecolor="black", label=label)
4562                for label in legend_labels
4563            ]
4564
4565            fig.legend(
4566                handles=legend_handles,
4567                loc="center right",
4568                bbox_to_anchor=legend_bbox,
4569                ncol=legend_split_col,
4570                title="",
4571            )
4572
4573            plt.tight_layout()
4574            plt.show()
4575
4576        else:
4577
4578            labels = [f"{row['pct']:.1f}%" for _, row in df.iterrows()]
4579
4580            legend_labels = [f"{row['name']}" for _, row in df.iterrows()]
4581
4582            cmap = plt.get_cmap(cmap)
4583            colors = [cmap(i / len(df)) for i in range(len(df))]
4584
4585            fig, ax = plt.subplots(
4586                figsize=(width, height), subplot_kw=dict(aspect="equal")
4587            )
4588
4589            wedges, _ = ax.pie(
4590                df["n"],
4591                startangle=90,
4592                labeldistance=1.05,
4593                colors=colors,
4594                wedgeprops={"linewidth": 0.5, "edgecolor": "black"},
4595            )
4596
4597            kw = dict(arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-"), zorder=0, va="center")
4598            n = 0
4599            for i, p in enumerate(wedges):
4600                ang = (p.theta2 - p.theta1) / 2.0 + p.theta1
4601                y = np.sin(np.deg2rad(ang))
4602                x = np.cos(np.deg2rad(ang))
4603                horizontalalignment = {-1: "right", 1: "left"}[int(np.sign(x))]
4604                connectionstyle = "angle,angleA=0,angleB={}".format(ang)
4605                kw["arrowprops"].update({"connectionstyle": connectionstyle})
4606                if len(labels[i]) > 0:
4607                    n += offset_labels
4608
4609                    ax.annotate(
4610                        labels[i],
4611                        xy=(x, y),
4612                        xytext=(1.01 * x + (n * x / 4), y * 1.01 + (n * y / 4)),
4613                        horizontalalignment=horizontalalignment,
4614                        fontsize=font_size,
4615                        weight="bold",
4616                        **kw,
4617                    )
4618
4619            circle2 = plt.Circle((0, 0), 0.6, color="white")
4620            circle2.set_edgecolor("black")
4621
4622            p = plt.gcf()
4623            p.gca().add_artist(circle2)
4624
4625            ax.legend(
4626                wedges,
4627                legend_labels,
4628                title="",
4629                loc="center left",
4630                bbox_to_anchor=legend_bbox,
4631                ncol=legend_split_col,
4632            )
4633
4634            plt.show()
4635
4636        return fig
